newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola board approves buyback program.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola board approves buyback program.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said it will buy back an additional 10 percent of its outstanding shares during the next 10 years with a new share repurchase program its board approved on Thursday.
The plan authorizes the repurchase of 206 million shares through the year 2006. There are 44 million shares remaining in the existing repurchase plan, Coca-Cola said.
Together, a total of a quarter billion shares are authorized for repurchase over the next 10 years, representing 10 percent of outstanding shares, Coca-Cola said.
Coca-Cola shares were trading at 49-1/8 late Thursday morning, up from the 48-1/2 close.
